en.title: H
en.summary: The letter name is Ha, as in the word Haus.

sections.title: The letter Ha
paragraphs: The letter name is (Ha) /haː/. Its main sound appears in (Haus) /haʊ̯s/, which means house. This letter has one spoken sound and can also be silent.

sections.title: Saying the sound
paragraphs: Open your mouth slightly and keep your tongue relaxed. Push breath gently through your open throat without voice. Place a hand on your throat to check that it does not shake. You will feel a warm puff of air on your fingers.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: At the start of a word or root, pronounce the breath in (Hand) /hant/. You also pronounce it in (hoffen) /ˈhɔfn̩/. When placed after a vowel, it is a silent letter that makes the vowel long. You hear this long vowel in (sehen) /ˈzeːən/ and in (fahren) /ˈfaːʁən/.

sections.title: Avoiding mistakes
paragraphs: Do not drop this breath at the start of words like hat. Do not make a scraping sound from the back of your mouth. Keep the breath smooth and light, exactly like the first sound in English home.
